candidates.change_summary: Require that msg.sender is the owner OR that the recipient is the owner (relaxes access control), potentially changing whether funds are transferred and thus the contract balance after withdrawAll.
Invert the require so only non-owners can call withdrawAll, changing whether the transfer occurs for the original owner caller.
Change the transfer to send zero value (no-op transfer), so balance remains unchanged after withdrawAll.
Replace transfer amount with half the balance, so only half the funds are withdrawn changing post-call balance.
Swap the order: transfer first, then require the caller is owner (could revert after transfer if not owner, affecting final balance), making behavior different.
